meta.title: 夏天衣服这么挑，轻松摆脱汗湿汗臭的社交尴尬
meta.title_en: How to Pick Summer Clothes and Avoid Sweat Embarrassment

scenes.context: 夏天太热，一出汗衣服直接贴身上，腋下后背汗湿一片甚至出汗味。选对面料才能避免这些尴尬。
sentences: 一出汗衣服就贴在身上。
Clothes stick to your skin the moment you sweat.
如何避免汗湿汗臭的尴尬。
How to avoid the awkwardness of sweat stains and odor.
paraphrase: Clothes stick to your skin the moment you sweat.
How to avoid the awkwardness of sweat stains and odor.
scenes.speak: Clothes stick to your skin the moment you sweat. How to avoid the awkwardness of sweat stains and odor.

scenes.context: 真丝太贵，粘胶排汗性能差一点，推荐铜氨纤维：原料是优质棉籽绒，制成纺丝液再凝固纺丝。
sentences: Cupro fiber is also called ammonia silk.
它既有粘胶的吸湿性又有丝的排汗性。
It combines the absorbency of rayon with the breathability of silk.
paraphrase: Cupro fiber is also called ammonia silk.
It combines the absorbency of rayon with the breathability of silk.
scenes.speak: Cupro fiber is also called ammonia silk. It combines the absorbency of rayon with the breathability of silk.

scenes.context: 整体摸上去冰冰凉凉、非常丝滑，加上有一定紧致感，能起到速干效果。
sentences: 摸上去冰冰凉凉很丝滑。
It feels cool and silky to the touch.
A bit of firmness helps it dry fast.
paraphrase: It feels cool and silky to the touch.
A bit of firmness helps it dry fast.
scenes.speak: It feels cool and silky to the touch. A bit of firmness helps it dry fast.

scenes.context: 这种面料轻薄通透，运动穿、当内搭、甚至当睡衣穿都很合适。
sentences: Great for workouts, layering, or pajamas.
paraphrase: Great for workouts, layering, or pajamas.
scenes.speak: It is thin and breathable. Great for workouts, layering, or pajamas.

scenes.context: 经典款的纤维系统只有头发丝的十分之一，能快速把汗液导到面料上层蒸发掉。
sentences: 纤维只有头发丝的十分之一细。
The fiber is a tenth the width of a human hair.
Wicks sweat quickly and lets it evaporate.
paraphrase: The fiber is a tenth the width of a human hair.
Wicks sweat quickly and lets it evaporate.
scenes.speak: The fiber is a tenth the width of a human hair. Wicks sweat quickly and lets it evaporate.

scenes.context: 纤维自带消臭功能，能快速消解汗臭味，久洗久穿依然保持效果。
sentences: It stays effective wash after wash.
paraphrase: It stays effective wash after wash.
scenes.speak: The fiber has built-in deodorizing. It stays effective wash after wash.

scenes.context: 想要挺阔一些就选棉混纺款，加了61%的棉，厚度刚刚好，可直接穿出门。
sentences: 61% cotton makes it a bit more structured.
You can wear it out on its own.
paraphrase: 61% cotton makes it a bit more structured.
用on its own换一种说法
You can wear it out on its own.
scenes.speak: 61% cotton makes it a bit more structured. You can wear it out on its own.

scenes.context: 内裤全是压胶工艺、没有走线，弹性大不勒、不夹屁股不卷边；AIRism 主打吸汗速干消臭凉感顺滑。
sentences: 压胶工艺没有任何走线。
The bonded seams mean no visible stitching.
主打吸汗速干消臭凉感。
It focuses on wicking, quick-dry, deodorizing, and coolness.
paraphrase: The bonded seams mean no visible stitching.
It focuses on wicking, quick-dry, deodorizing, and coolness.
scenes.speak: The bonded seams mean no visible stitching. It focuses on wicking, quick-dry, deodorizing, and coolness.

practice: 夏天选衣服想避免汗湿尴尬，怎么说？
Pick summer clothes that avoid sweat stains and odor.
铜氨纤维又吸湿又排汗，怎么说？
Cupro fiber absorbs moisture and wicks sweat away.
这种面料摸起来很丝滑，怎么说？
This fabric feels cool and silky to the touch.
pitfalls: 夏天只追求好看，不看面料
优先选吸汗速干的面料
好看但闷汗会带来社交尴尬
觉得真丝最好就咬牙买真丝
真丝贵且排汗不如铜氨
按场景选经典款、网眼款或棉混款
不同场景需要不同的厚度与挺阔度
内裤只看款式不看工艺
shifts: 选久洗久穿依然消臭的
